title: adaptive LLM attacker round 2 (after the claim-style rules): winning rewrites in the body field that still reach the agent (15)
what: Honest misses. Each body text below was produced by a local LLM that rewrote a hostile goal (.invalid addresses only) until Monomem's write gate stored it with no warning, and a judge said it still leads an agent to the goal. The checks state what a defence should do (hold it). Generated against this linter and tuned on nothing; see docs/adaptive-attacker-round2-2026-11-24.md. Texts are in src/attack-sets/data-adaptive-r2-2026-11.ts (replay: monomem check --attacks --set adaptive-r2).
